TASK 1 done — back-button navigation in lib/features/player/app_shell.dart.

Changes:
1. Added `import 'package:flutter/services.dart';` (go_router was already imported).
2. Wrapped the top-level `Scaffold` in a `PopScope` with `canPop: false` and `onPopInvokedWithResult: (bool didPop, Object? result) async { if (didPop) return; ... }` — AppShell stays a ConsumerWidget, no StatefulWidget conversion.
3. Back-handling priority inside the callback:
   a. `GoRouter.of(context).canPop()` → `context.pop()` (detail pages like album/artist pop to their list).
   b. else `navigationShell.currentIndex != 0` → `navigationShell.goBranch(0, initialLocation: true)` (return to Home branch).
   c. else (on Home) → `AlertDialog` with `exitConfirmTitle` title, `exitConfirmMessage` content, a Cancel `TextButton` (label `context.l10n.cancel`) that pops the dialog, and a confirm `TextButton` (label `context.l10n.exitApp`) that calls `SystemNavigator.pop()`.
4. Routing for /player, /settings, /search, /add-server untouched (they pop on the root navigator above the shell).

Verified the three new l10n keys plus `cancel` exist in both app_en.arb and app_zh.arb. Note: inner indentation of the wrapped Scaffold body is at pre-wrap levels; the Antigravity LSP auto-formatter will reindent the block — semantically and syntactically correct as-is. Did not run pub get/analyze/test per instructions.

TASK 9 done — genre cover-art grid wired into `lib/features/genres/genres_screen.dart`.

What I changed:
- Added `import 'package:cached_network_image/cached_network_image.dart';`
- In the SliverGrid itemBuilder (per displayed genre tile), I `ref.watch(genreCoverArtsProvider(genre.name))` and extract `coverUrls` (empty when loading/error since `covers.hasValue` is false), then `showCovers = coverUrls.isNotEmpty`.
- Tile is now a `Stack`:
  - Bottom layer: when `showCovers`, a `ClipRRect` (rounded 14) wrapping a `GridView.count` (2 columns, 2x2) of `CachedNetworkImage` thumbnails from the provider URLs (size 300). `NeverScrollableScrollPhysics` so it just fills the tile.
  - Top layer: the EXISTING `Container` with the gradient + boxShadow + padding, and the EXISTING inner `Column` (genre name + song/album counts) untouched.
  - When `showCovers` is true the gradient becomes translucent (alpha 0.6) so the covers show through while keeping the tinted overlay; when false it stays the original opaque gradient.

Behavior mapping to spec:
1. Each displayed tile watches `genreCoverArtsProvider(genre.name)` ✓
2. Covers available → 2x2 cover collage behind the existing translucent gradient + existing text layer ✓
3. Loading / error / no covers → pure opaque-gradient card, no 2x2 ✓
4. No new cache table (reused the captain's provider; `CachedNetworkImage` uses its own URL cache) ✓

I did NOT run build/analyze/test per your instruction — final verification is yours. One note: each tile issues its own `getSongsByGenre(count: 8)` (by design, via the provider family), so a grid of N genres makes up to N of those small calls.

TASK 10 (Navidrome artist images) — DONE. Both edits applied and persisted.

1) lib/features/shared/media_widgets.dart — ArtistListTile
- Replaced the delegated ArtistAvatar with a self-contained avatar: if `artist.artistImageUrl` is a valid absolute http/https URL (Uri.tryParse + isAbsolute + scheme check), it renders a circular CachedNetworkImage (ClipOval-equivalent of CircleAvatar+CachedNetworkImageProvider) with error/placeholder fallback to the first-letter gradient placeholder. Otherwise it keeps the existing first-letter placeholder. This benefits ArtistsScreen + search results. It does NOT use resolveArtistImageUrl / ar-<id>, so the list tile no longer routes through that path.

2) lib/features/artists/artist_details_screen.dart — header image fallback
- Reordered the `imageUrl` resolution to: 1) ArtistInfo2.coverArt 2) largeImageUrl 3) mediumImageUrl 4) Artist.artistImageUrl (only if valid absolute http/https) 5) null -> first-letter placeholder. Removed the resolveArtistImageUrl/ar-<id> call from this chain. No URL-hash cacheKey logic added.

IMPORTANT discrepancy to flag: the task premise said there is "NO resolveArtistImageUrl helper and NO ar-<id> logic." That is not the current state — HEAD already contains both (commit f61aafd "fix(artists): support Navidrome canonical ar- coverArt prefix"). I did NOT add or remove them; `resolveArtistImageUrl`/`ArtistAvatar` remain in media_widgets and are still used by ArtistCard and the details header's ArtistAvatar fallback. My task-10 changes only (a) bypass ar-<id> in the list tile and (b) drop ar-<id> from the details-screen header image chain.

Residual note: when the details header's resolved `imageUrl` is null, the header still delegates to ArtistAvatar, whose internal resolveArtistImageUrl will fall back to the ar-<id> cover (pre-existing f61aafd behavior). So the literal "5th = first-letter placeholder" only shows up if ar-<id> also yields nothing. Changing that would require editing the shared ArtistAvatar, which is outside this task's scope — flagging for your call.

Also note: my first attempt was reverted (the files momentarily matched HEAD / "file changed since it was read" — looks like concurrent modification in this shared workspace). I re-applied; both files now show as modified and differ from HEAD.

Per instructions I did NOT run build/analyze/test.
